title: On cyclic invariants of the free associative algebra
summary: Let $K\langle X_d\rangle$ be the free associative algebra of rank $d \geq 2$ over a field $K$. Lane in 1976 and Kharchenko in 1978 proved that the algebra of invariants $K\langle X_d\rangle^G$ is free for any subgroup $G \leq \text{GL}_d(K)$ and any field $K$. Later, Kharchenko introduced an additional action of the symmetric group $\text{Sym}(n)$ on the homogeneous component of degree $n$ of $K\langle X_d\rangle$, given by permuting the positions of the variables.
